_what: Mechanical application of m17/registry.json:training.decision_protocol to the complete 6d screen matrix (arms C, V, L, VL, VL-A; seed 0; 4000 steps). No new quality read was taken; every number here comes from the already-spent reads listed under `inputs`.
surface: m7/m8 pinned development suite (six components), exact dense retrieval, int8 folded table, loader resident_int8, dev_manifest_sha256 4f991015db4407080ed9c8d1d2a85541d34b1e676aa593e510296eedca77e2ea

reference.question: Which registered v1 numbers do the eligibility predicates compare against?
reference.registry_evidence: m17/registry.json states the predicates only in words ('loss vs v1', training.decision_protocol.eligibility) and names no results/ file, no per-component reference set and no v1 dev-suite read record. m17/PLANNING.md likewise says 'eligibility against v1' without naming numbers. No v1 read was taken or budgeted inside M17 (no v1 bundle under work/m17/bundles/, no v1 entry in the read ledger).

used.why_this_row: p35w-2m-s2500 is the released Zero v1 run (m7/FREEZE.json:run_id); results/m7_dev_audit_full.json:tables['p35w-2m-s2500'].sha256 = a7007b1a6af120b976f093fd69ddcb5001996ec0b84b5864b4fd25d7af878abf equals m7/FREEZE.json:table_sha256; the released serving variant is int8 with preproc pool_mode 'sqrt' (m7/FREEZE.json:preproc.pool_mode), so |int8|pool-sqrt is the shipped configuration; the audit covers exactly the same six pinned components with the same query counts.
caveats: This file is NOT named by m17/registry.json; it is the M7 audit that happens to hold the released table's read on the identical pinned suite. It is labelled exploratory selection evidence in its own _status field.

results/m7_dev_audit_full.json:tables['p35w-2m-s2500'].meta_sha256 (7eb5c066...) differs from m7/FREEZE.json:table_meta_sha256 (14f117b8...); the table bytes match, the metadata sidecar of the pool-variant sweep does not.

Corroboration: the untrained V0 export (v1 rows unchanged plus 446 sum-init rows) reproduces this reference to 2.1e-5 macro and <= 8.0e-5 on every component, which is what V0's definition predicts. The choice of reference therefore does not change any verdict below.

substitute_if_the_above_is_rejected.label: SUBSTITUTE, not a registered v1 reference: V0 is the untrained extended export, explicitly 'descriptive only, never a shippable candidate' (registry training.untrained_vocab_export_v0). Deciding against it is not what the protocol says.
substitute_if_the_above_is_rejected.note: Every per-arm verdict below is identical under this substitute, because V0 and the v1 reference differ by <= 8.0e-5 per component.

fused_macro_predicate.required_by: training.decision_protocol.eligibility ('AND fused_macro loss vs v1 <= general_macro_ndcg_loss_tolerance') and general_metric ('the existing four-component fused_macro')
fused_macro_predicate.reason: The five screen.json reads carry only macro/per-component nDCG@10, recall@10 and per-query nDCG@10. They contain no ranked run dicts, no retrieval scores and no BM25 runs. m12src/qfusion.py (and m7src/fusion.py) need runs of the form {qid: {docid: score}} for both the dense and the lexical side; nothing in the spent reads supplies them. Re-scoring to produce them would be a new dev-suite read, which is forbidden.
fused_macro_predicate.operator_note: The registered confirmatory fusion operator for this predicate is M7's convex0 at param 0.8 (m7/FREEZE.json:fusion, dev_macro 0.5726634997854769 over the four text components). M12's DBSF@100 is a disclosed product-policy override, not this predicate.
fused_macro_predicate.effect_on_the_verdict: None. Eligibility is a conjunction; every arm already fails both the dense macro term and the per-component term, so the missing fused term cannot rescue any arm.

screen_ordering_walk.why: screen_ordering ranks 'Among eligible arms'. The eligible set is empty, so the control-map walk (VL-A vs VL, then VL vs L and VL vs V, then L vs C and V vs C) selects nothing and no finalist exists.

descriptive_only_technical_contrasts_cqa._note: Recorded for the record; these decide nothing because no arm is eligible. Tie band 0.003.

screen_ordering_walk.descriptive_only_note: Even if eligibility were set aside, VL-A does not beat VL (negative) and VL does not beat L (negative), so the walk would stop at L, and L's matched control is C.

verdict.clause_text: If no arm is eligible, or C is the finalist, record 'no useful signal from this screen' and stop before full runs; the reserve is not spent on a second screen
verdict.record: no useful signal from this screen
consequences_as_written: The reserve is not spent on a second screen.
verdict.arithmetic: Every arm's six-component dense macro loss vs v1 is between 0.0215 and 0.0347, i.e. 7x to 11x the 0.003 tolerance; every arm also loses more than 0.01 on at least three components (worst: heldout-train, 0.090 to 0.119). The eligibility conjunction fails on two independent terms for all five arms; the third term (fused_macro) is not computable from the spent reads and cannot change a conjunction that has already failed.
not_decided_here: Why the trained arms sit below the untrained export. See the non-quality diagnosis in the accompanying report; no protocol change, re-decision or new read is implied by this file.
Whether the missing registered v1 reference is itself a protocol gap that the owner must rule on.
